messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: 3xx OOMs + CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS observed in pool-14 (us-west1). Auto-restarts triggered on 3 nodes in the group. Dashboard: https://redwood/dashboard/incidents/44422 :rotating_light:
monica: I'm on it — oncall starting triage. Seeing surge in page faults and allocator refcount churn. Root container restarts correlate with 'nvml: GPU reset' followed by 'kvcache: reclaim failed'.
sam: preliminary look — this smells like KV-reservoir fragmentation. The paged-attn allocator is leaving many tiny free slices; compaction isn't keeping up. Logs show repeated:
```
# logs excerpt
kvcache: slab_alloc failed size=208k, free_list_count=3
paged_attn: page_fault: slot_count=8192, free_frag=<0.7%
allocator: coalesce_attempts=0, last_compact=2026-03-14T02:11:09Z
cuda: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS @ kernel launch
```
sam: also seeing a slow creep of resident memory over ~6 hours before OOMs. Not a sudden leak, more of fragmentation accumulation.
lee: agree with sam. Can we cordon the 3 flapping nodes and route traffic away while we triage? If container restarts keep happening, they'd cause cascading evictions.
monica: cordoning now. `kubectl cordon node/us-west1-node-14a` -> draining non-critical pods. Will also flip fallback routing to small-quantized model for pool-14 to lower memory pressure.
monica: flipping routing: `deploy-bot: route set pool-14 --model rwd-small-quant --reason "live mitigation kv-frag"` :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: @monica request acknowledged. Routing change applied to pool-14 (canary 10% -> 100%).
tara: customer-impact update: Support flagged three customers (acct: big-retailer, search-api, demo-tenant) with 503s and timeouts ~30-60s during the flare. I've opened tickets and pinged reps. No P0 escalations yet, but search-api is retrying and hitting higher latency. :phone:
sam: short-term mitigation plan: 1) trigger manual kvcache eviction/compact on affected nodes, 2) restart containers gracefully with `--kv-compact` enabled, 3) set a temporary aggressive eviction threshold (evict_ratio=0.6). Command plan below:
```
# ops commands
rdwctl nodes exec --nodes us-west1-node-14a,us-west1-node-14b -- \
  "rdwctl cache compact --target=high && rdwctl service restart inference-runtime --grace=30"
kubectl annotate node/us-west1-node-14a redwood/maintenance=kv-compact
```
sam: doing step 1 now on 14a and 14b. Monitoring mem stats.
monica: after compact+restart on 14a we saw resident drop ~1.2GB and allocation churn subsided for ~12m. 14b similar. 14c still flapping, will schedule restart.
lee: to reduce blast radius let's enable node-level fallback to CPU runtime for non-latency-critical routes and enable model fallback in the router policy for the tenant with high errors. Also please capture kernel dumps and nvml logs for the flapping nodes.
sam: capturing nvml logs + core dumps, uploading to gcs://redwood-incidents/4442200000/ for postmortem. PR for a medium-term allocator patch (coalesce-on-free + background-scavenge) is here: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/5982 — it's experimental but includes a background defragger.
tara: I'll send a customer note summarizing mitigations and ETA for a proper fix (tomorrow EOD).
monica: handoff — current state: routing fallback applied, manual compaction completed on two nodes, third node restarted and stabilized after kernel dump collection. Customer impact reduced (latency normalized for most), tickets opened. Handoff to eng-runtime for follow-up and root-cause & patch rollout.
monica: handing off to @sam and @lee for tomorrow's deep dive — leaving this thread in the incident channel. Runbook link: https://redwood/runbooks/kv-frag-handoff. Please call me if any new flaps occur. :wave:
sam: ack — will pick up postmortem, include heapmaps, fragmentation heatmaps, and propose a scavenger daemon. Planning a canary rollout for allocator patch with 1% traffic next week.
lee: leaving monitoring alerts to SRE: set temporary lower thresholds for eviction and auto-restart suppression for 5m to avoid restart loops. Also scheduling postmortem at 2026-03-15 09:30 PT.
monica: thanks team. Closing live mitigation loop. If anyone finds additional affected tenants, add them to the incident ticket. :eyes:
